Definition: to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine
BiblicalUsage: The word is to beat the timbrel, to drum. The singers go before and the players on instruments follow after, and among them are the damsels playing with timbrels; and in Nineveh's fall the maids lead her with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe music belongs both to the procession of worship and to the mourning of a fallen city.
